name: Worldz LinkedAsset™
purpose: Let any WorldzLaunchPad project voluntarily connect its token to one or more verified external or Worldz ecosystem assets for user-directed swaps, disclosed pair/liquidity construction, cross-chain development and mutually approved ecosystem support.

capabilities.name: Linked Swap
capabilities.description: Expose user-initiated swap routes between the project token and a verified linked asset where a supported venue/aggregator route exists.

capabilities.name: Linked Pair
capabilities.description: Build a disclosed project-token / linked-asset liquidity pair when the chain-native venue supports it.

capabilities.name: Omni Pair
capabilities.description: Use an approved wrapped/native representation and verified bridge/adaptor to construct a cross-chain liquidity route without pretending the same token contract exists on every chain.

capabilities.name: Linked Buildz
capabilities.description: Share approved infrastructure, integrations, launch tooling, proofs, developer grants or co-marketing surfaces between opted-in projects.

capabilities.name: Linked Support
capabilities.description: Allow a project to route a disclosed portion of its own approved ecosystem/treasury budget to a linked project or shared build objective. This is not an automatic market purchase.

capabilities.name: Linked Proof
capabilities.description: Publish asset identity, approvals, pair addresses, bridge/wrapper identity, transactions and current activation state.

requiredChecks: source project is registered and verified
linked asset contract/mint and chain are verified
official links and provenance are recorded
linked project or asset controller approval is recorded when an affiliation/co-build claim is requested
all fees/budgets/LP ownership and lock rules are disclosed
simulation and wallet/multisig signature boundary are preserved
linkHandshake.oneSidedPublicLinkAllowed: A Worldz project may link to a verified public asset for ordinary user-directed swap/pair functionality without claiming partnership, provided the integration is technically valid and the UI clearly says no affiliation is implied.
linkHandshake.mutualBrandingRule: Partnership, official integration, co-build or branded profile language requires evidence of counterparty opt-in.

fields: Capabilities: Swap / Pair / Omni Pair / Buildz / Support

allowedBeforeCounterpartyOptIn: display as a verified public Solana asset
offer user-directed swap routing when supported
prepare an opt-in request for Ansem/asset controllers
blockedBeforeCounterpartyOptIn: routing project treasury or fees to an Ansem-controlled destination without verified destination and approval

blackBullExample.relationshipNote: The referenced Black Bull site states it is community-built and not affiliated with Ansem.
blackBullExample.activationRule: Do not create or advertise a BlackBull token preset until a specific asset mint/contract and provenance are verified. The generic LinkedAsset handshake remains available.
